steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're no match for me!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You defeated all my comrades single-handedly? Perhaps I must re-evaluate your abilities, Madam.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's enough.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: No, far from it. Faust, give her a shake-down.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Those on the roof, get down!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Ahh!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Reunion's sniper...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (I even made sure to prepare for ranged attacks, but how does he pack this much firepower...?)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's not enough to save your life. You'll die before your sniper can land a shot on me.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Wait. Were you arrested by the L.G.D. before?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Your bunch caused him a great deal of grief. But it's nothing compared to what Ursus did to us.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: He missed that shot on purpose, dear Madam. We'll spare your life this once, so take this as a gesture of kindness.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Right now, the seeds of unrest have been sown within the L.G.D.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: It was your organization's corruption and negligence that gave him the chance to cooperate with us.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Reunion scum, you know nothing about this world.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Were you trying to say something profound?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did you think that Faust was rescued by Reunion?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: There were many Infected in the L.G.D. at the time.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Twenty-one.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did you think that at least four of them would side with Reunion?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But even those four were set up by me. After they got in contact with you, did you lock one of them up?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Very clever, Madam. She ran away.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Have you still not realized the situation you're now in?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Of course I've figured it out. My squad has been crushed, and I'm the only one left.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Our forces wandering around outside are hopelessly weak, and my comrades have basically lost their will to fight.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Is this what you wanted to hear me say?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I suppose you're not that arrogant after all.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Well then... Come, my guards.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Rise.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Ugh... argh... Ooaarrrggh!!!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What did you do?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The bits of Originium on their bodies... are growing?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: The Originium will pierce through their bodies and become their new form.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Behold, Officer. These are my guards, my immortal guards.

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: GRAAAAAAGHHH!!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Take it all, my herd, my comrades...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Fwoo...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Powder...?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: My comrades need healing. They need me.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Arts? All squads, be on alert! The enemy commander is casting wide-range Arts using some kind of powder!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Don't worry, Madam. This does not concern you, as you are not my comrade.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Ugh... Aagghh—

steps.name: ReUni N MemBr
steps.text: ...Unghh... Nnngh!

steps.name: ReUMmbr? N;E? OE
steps.text: Nghhhaaahghh...
Grrraaaaaaaaaaaghh!

steps.name: Mephisto's hERd
steps.text: ...Blood!! Blood!! Aaaargh!!! Aaaaaggh!!!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Quiet now.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, it's looking bad...

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: All the defeated Reunion members started to transform into hulking monstrosities after coming in contact with that powder!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: They've started attacking us again, and they're slowly moving towards our defense line!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just how many of them have transformed?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: All of them!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: They are my herd, as well as my brethren.

steps.name: Mephisto's Herd
steps.text: ...Urgh.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: They shall never fall, because I will take away all their pain.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're just manipulating them like puppets. How can you call them your brethren?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I see no difference between the two. For the greater good, we are willing to become anything.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If this is what you call the greater good... Looks like you're the only one I need to get rid of.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You have a sense of purpose, and the will to get it done. I'm quite drawn to you, Madam.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Focus your fire! Hurry! Aim at the enemy commander!

steps.name: Mephisto's Guard
steps.text: Urrrrgghhhh...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But you'll find that my guards are not so easily defeated.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: They just blocked the explosion with their flesh... and they're completely unscathed?!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: That amount of firepower... should've been enough to blast through a layer of the city's fortified walls!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Don't waste your effort.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Wounds will heal. Flesh will harden. Life will return.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Their weapons cannot hurt my guards. After all, I prepared them especially for you.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Rise, my comrades. Don't let anyone interfere with our conversation.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, Reunion is attacking us wave after wave! We can't defeat them using conventional methods!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Damn it, do they not feel any pain?!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: The other squads are also in the same situation! The Reunion members outside have also started moving. They keep charging towards the headquarters, trying to attack our security facilities!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Prioritize taking care of the enemies in your immediate vicinity!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Out of my way!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, these things have no sense of feeling at all! They've completely surrounded the L.G.D. Headquarters!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: We're being forced into melee combat! We won't be able to support you!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Take care of yourselves.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Roger!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Majestic, isn't it? After so many battles, their minds seem to have fallen apart, but their bodies are still healthy and strong.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Sheer strength seems to be able to slightly make up for mistakes in decision-making.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: At least we'll have ample time to slowly talk through our issues.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I'd like to have a fruitful discussion with you, Madam, about things that aren't related to this battle.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: There's no need for that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll just kill you right now.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: You're fast!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But not fast enough.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: She deflected my shot with her blade?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That black-haired kid has a good read on my movements.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Tsk... Looks like their plan is to harass me with sniper shots, and then predict my movements while blocking me off.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Sorry, Madam. I can pretty much predict all your possible moves. All I need to do is block you off a bit.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: This way, you'll never be able to close the gap. So, which do you prefer? Sharp arrows, explosive bolts, or heavy spikes?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Looks like you really came here prepared.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But when a chessmaster finishes his preparations, he's assuming that his opponent will be playing the other color.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: (Wait, why is my powder still sticking to her body...?)

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: (So that's what's going on, I see...)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm not good with the theoretical stuff like you, but I simply come prepared for everything.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your chessboard cannot contain me, brat. I am no chess piece. I am Lungmen's blade.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: The line between bravery and stupidity is fine indeed.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Or were you planning to pull out some kind of trump card? If I remember correctly, I've never seen you use that other sword of yours in combat.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Surely it's not just there for decoration, right?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This sword was not meant to be drawn against the likes of you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You aren't worth of it, no matter what.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: However, you must pay for your sins, for all you've done to the innocent people of Lungmen and Chernobog.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Right here, right now.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: This belongs to you now.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't need it.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Well, just treat it as a loan.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you not afraid?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Afraid of what? You turning against me?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No, I am not.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Because I am not scared of death.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: This is no ordinary weapon. You'll gradually come to understand it.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Do not waste its power on trivial things. A dragonslaying sword shall only be unsheathed against a worthy enemy.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Who you choose to draw this sword upon is entirely up to you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (...This sword is still hibernating.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (You still refuse to be unsheathed even in this situation...)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (But right now, Chi Xiao, you must drink their blood!)
